ABOUT.HEADING: Behind Canapé
ABOUT.NAME: Esteban Bravo
ABOUT.BIO_1: My perspective was shaped by a background in industrial design and years of experience in hospitality and gastronomy. I see every project as a whole: the idea, the space, the rhythm, the details and, above all, how people experience it.
ABOUT.BIO_2: I'm drawn to places with character, thoughtful decisions and generous hospitality, where everyone can feel they belong.
ABOUT.BIO_3: Canapé grew out of this way of seeing and creating: blending the familiar with the unexpected to craft gatherings and atmospheres with a distinct identity.
